template.title: Cautious review
template.summary: Generous iteration budget plus extra validation attempts and diagnostic rounds for hard-to-pin-down bugs.

note: Cautious-review template — high iteration cap, multiple validation attempts, deeper diagnostics.

config.yaml:
# dev-loop configuration for this repository.
#
# Template: cautious-review
# Spend more wall-clock for tricky failures the agent should keep investigating.

runs_dir: .dev-loop/runs
default_provider: replay
scenarios_dir: scenarios

policy:
  max_code_iterations: 15
  max_validation_attempts_per_iteration: 4
  max_diagnostic_rounds_per_failure: 6
  max_total_wall_clock_minutes: 240

notes: cautious-review template — go slow, keep digging.
